bar: joyful / obvious / frictionless vs WhatsApp & Slack

rubric.joyful: Warm, human, celebrates progress; list sells conversation not filenames; empty states inviting (0–100 vs WhatsApp/Slack).
rubric.obvious: Know where you are, who's here, what to do next; labels not mystery icons; links land where names promise — no misroutes (0–100).
rubric.frictionless: No full-page splash for in-app moves; phone works; one path to common actions; no dead ends (0–100).
